assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production game sprite atlas, 64 different citizen social-network profile portraits for a polished Spanish civic visual novel called CIVICA. Generate ONE square high-resolution PNG sprite sheet, ideally 4096x4096, exactly EIGHT columns and EIGHT rows, 64 equal square cells from edge to edge, NO gutters, NO grid lines, NO frames, NO lettering. Every cell contains a DIFFERENT fictional Latin American adult head and shoulders portrait, warm expressive anime/semi-realistic visual-novel illustration, refined clean line art, painterly detailed hair, believable faces, golden rim light, subtle cel shading, elegant navy/teal/terracotta clothing. Keep each head centered in its own square, all hair and shoulders entirely inside that cell with 8% transparent padding, heads similarly sized, front or slight three-quarter pose. Transparent backgrounds in all cells. Alternating WOMAN in even numbered cells and MAN in odd cells, row-major starting cell0 top-left. Wide diversity of skin tones (Afro-Latino, mestizo, Indigenous-Latino, light and dark complexions), ages20 through75, hairstyles short/long/curly/straight/braids/gray, glasses, facial hair, body types and occupations in everyday clothing. Each person must have an unmistakably unique face and hair; avoid repeating faces. First ten: young woman brown shoulder-length hair; young man dark wavy hair; woman dark curls; man chestnut short hair; woman black braids; man dark short hair with glasses; woman long wavy black hair; man short black hair with light beard; woman dark skin and curly auburn hair; man medium skin and thick eyebrows. Remaining54 diverse adults, alternating female/male. No copied famous people, no hats obscuring eyes, no text, no watermark, no bodies merged across cells. Crisp faces readable as circular thumbnails. The entire deliverable is an exact8x8 evenly tiled atlas.
